description: This file defines a 'Loader' UI component that displays animated circles to indicate loading state. It imports the LightningJS 'Blits' module and creates a component with reactive properties, hooks, and methods for animation.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component for displaying a loading animation with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins an interval that toggles the alpha transparency of the circles to create a fade-in and fade-out animation.
